decisions.statement: One workstation process does the pushing one thing to a tick.
Every notification written after the notification last seen is pushed.
A notification is a row in the feed of the person pushed at.
The first tick after a start begins at the newest row already there.
The cursor moves past each notification and only ever forward.
No push has an app-icon badge.
Nothing refreshes an app-icon badge on its own.
With the signing key unset every push is a logged no-op and the feed is still followed.
A tick still working past its ceiling ends the process rather than letting a second tick start.
The loop runs until that loop is asked to stop.
A tick that threw says what that tick had already delivered before it threw.
Each tick is handed a list of its own rather than one the loop keeps filling.
A stop ends that loop at the next boundary.
The feed is read and written in pages data rather than in the pages system service.

definition: every notification written for Alan pushed at his devices
